text:
I visited So Shine Samui today for waxing (underarms, lower legs/knee down, and full Hollywood/Brazilian).

The appointment was very fast — I was completely done within about 30 minutes for all three areas. She worked quickly and checked several times if the wax temperature was okay, which I appreciated.

Price-wise, it’s probably hard to beat: 1,300 THB for all three areas is very affordable.

However, the overall hygiene and setup were concerning to me. The treatment room and waxing station did not feel particularly clean, and definitely not hygienic or sterile. From what I could see, the wooden spatulas in the wax pot did not appear to be single-use — there were several already inside, and it didn’t seem like a fresh one was used each time.

There was no visible pre-care before waxing. Powder was applied afterward, and a milk lotion was used on the legs. She also offered to apply more lotion at the end. However, there wasn’t thorough skin preparation beforehand or soothing aftercare like cooling aloe. I also still had some wax residue left on my body after the appointment.

She did use tweezers to remove some ingrown or remaining visible hairs, which I appreciated. However, there are still quite a few individual hairs left in different areas, so the result isn’t as smooth as I’ve experienced elsewhere.

I also noticed a small red patch on one knee immediately after — nothing serious, likely just a reaction to heat or skin sensitivity.

Overall:
Very fast and very affordable. For the price, it may suit travelers who are looking for a quick and budget-friendly option. Personally, I value a higher level of hygiene, skin preparation, and finishing detail, so I’ve had more thorough experiences elsewhere.
